caption: The drawing depicts a single, short-sleeved dress laid flat, with a gathered neckline that is tied at the back with a small bow. The dress is predominantly light beige or off-white in color and features an all-over floral print pattern consisting of small red, green, and blue flowers with their accompanying leaves and stems. The bodice is gathered and fitted at the waist with a thin waistband, from which the skirt flares out in a full, rounded shape. The sleeves are slightly puffed and end just above the elbow, trimmed with a narrow, darker border matching the print colors. The background of the image is plain without any additional objects or details, focusing attention solely on the garment. The artist’s signature, “V. Bergez,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Child's Dress
